key_developments.event: Battle of Legnano — Lombard infantry defeats Barbarossa's cavalry.
Peace of Constance — Empire recognises communal autonomy.
Second Lombard League reformed against Frederick II.

_quarry.description: An alliance of north Italian communes — Milan, Verona, Padua, Vicenza, Cremona, Bologna and others — formed in 1167 to resist the Italian campaigns of Frederick I Barbarossa. The League's victory at Legnano (1176) and the subsequent Peace of Constance (1183) confirmed substantial communal autonomy within the Holy Roman Empire, a milestone in the political development of the Italian city-states.
